svg.title: Brick Breaker uplift: the machines set, as drafts
svg.text: Machines: levels 41 to 50
Brick Breaker uplift · the Machines set, as drafts · dark palette
The arcade · new: bumper, slider, portal · no draft is a level until the autopilot has cleared it

g.text: the last one opens the gates
steel until the keys are gone

svg.text: 50 Grand machine
The set's last: a portal to the roof, a belt, bumpers, and two strongrooms behind gates.
41 Pinball
Bumpers: round, so a ball leaves one
at an angle no brick gives.
33 bricks · 33 hits · star at a streak of 15
42 Conveyor
Sliders: a row of them steps a cell at
a time and turns at a wall.
38 bricks · 38 hits · star at a streak of 10
43 Wormhole
A portal: in the low one, out of its
twin, into the pocket above the wall.
52 bricks · 58 hits · star at a streak of 20
Levels 41 to 50, in the arcade. Three kinds are new: the bumper (41),
the slider (42) and the portal (43). They are the kinds that move a
ball or themselves, so this is the set where the field stops being
still. The pace runs from 1.16 to 1.22, the fastest of the fifty.
44 Tilt
A table: plated lanes funnel a ball
onto three bumpers.
23 bricks · 23 hits · star at a streak of 10
45 Typewriter
Three trains of sliders sweep under a
wall, each against the next.
37 bricks · 37 hits · star at a streak of 15
46 Two rooms
Two sealed rooms of gifts, each with a
portal for a door.
33 bricks · 38 hits · star at a streak of 10
47 Clockwork
A picture: three gears, a bumper for
each one's hub, and a belt of sliders.
39 bricks · 41 hits · star at a streak of 10
48 Switchyard
The keys are in two sealed rooms; the
portals are the only way to them.
25 bricks · 25 hits · star at a streak of 15
49 Pachinko
Pegs and cups: the cups are plated, so
they fill from above.
24 bricks · 30 hits · star at a streak of 10
